name: Is it better to use flat, eggshell, satin, or semi-gloss paint?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to use flat, eggshell, satin, or semi-gloss paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best paint finish depends on the room's function and traffic. Flat paint hides imperfections well but is less durable and harder to clean, making it suitable for low-traffic areas like ceilings. Eggshell and satin finishes offer more durability and are easier to clean, ideal for living rooms and bedrooms. Semi-gloss and gloss paints are highly durable, moisture-resistant, and washable, making them excellent choices for kitchens, bathrooms, trim, and doors. Consider the practical tradeoff between appearance and ease of maintenance for each area of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose paint finish based on room use: flat for low-traffic areas, eggshell/satin for general rooms, semi-gloss for high-moisture or high-traffic areas and trim.
